nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Deep Cleansing Foam

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin generally describe the cleanser as well suited to them, controlling sebum and not leaving skin dry, though one reviewer with very oily skin still saw visible dryness and flaking.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: some find it suits them well and leaves skin soft and plump, while others report it dries their skin out or that they must limit use to once a week.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe it as a good daily option that cleans well without stripping.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report a gentle, non-stinging, non-irritating cleanse, though one with sensitive skin experienced new breakouts over continued use.

concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers say the cleanser cleans without the tight, stripped feeling typical of foaming cleansers, but a notable minority (including one with very oily skin) report visible dryness, patchiness, or flaking after use.
concerns.redness: One reviewer noted calmer, more balanced skin with less redness after several days of use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the product's gentleness with helping heal her skin barrier while clearing acne; another with sensitive skin says it does not sting or strip the barrier.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report pores looking smaller, tighter, or visibly clearer with continued use, with no dissent on this point.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report fewer breakouts, clearer skin, or acne and dark spots improving within about two weeks; however, two reviewers say the product caused new pimples or breakouts to appear on their skin.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin say it keeps sebum in check and helps balance oil, especially in warmer months.

aspects.libelle: Small amount goes a long way
Reasonable value, lasts a long time

extraits.texte: i was sent the Madagascar Centella Poreminimizing Deep Cleansing Foam from Bzzagent for free in exchange for my honest review. I have sensitive skin, so I'm always cautious with new cleansers. The cleanser has a nice, rich lather and a little goes a long way. I really liked that it left my skin feeling clean without that tight, dry feeling some foaming cleansers can cause. During use, it felt gentle and not irritating at all. However, after continued use, I did experience breakouts, which was disappointing. While it didn't cause immediate redness or stinging, my skin did not react well over time. Overall, I think this cleanser may work well for those who don't have acne-prone or highly reactive skin, but unfortunately it wasn't a good match for my sensitive skin.
This product feels really rich, thick, and creamy when applying but after I use it, my skin visibly looks dry and patchy. I can see white skin flakes covering my face, and I have very oily skin!

I absolutely love this cleansing foam. It lathers beautifully and leaves my skin feeling clean without that tight, stripped feeling. I have acne-prone and sensitive skin, and this has helped keep my pores looking clearer while still feeling gentle and soothing. A little goes a long way, and it rinses off easily without any residue. My skin feels soft and refreshed.

I've been using it for the past three weeks after it was kindly sent to me for free by Skin1004. I use it with two other cleansers I already use and I can already tell my skin loves this cleanser. I use it twice a week and it has never made my oily skin dry or dehydrated. It makes my face clean, smooth, and never irritated. A little goes a long way and it doesn't smell like anything! I haven't gotten any breakouts because of it the past three weeks, so I recommend it if you are looking for a not too harsh cleanser.

Thanks Skin1004 for sending the product Madagascar Centella Poremizing Deep Cleansing Foam for free. It is a rich creamy cleanser that gently exfoliates your skin without leaving it irritated or dried. I have a dry skin and it suits my skin. Every time I use it, my skin feels fresh, soft and plump. I would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a good cleanser.

I have tested many face washes in the 20 years that I've had acne. This one is very gentle, doesn't dry my skin out, and leaves my skin feeling wonderfully clean. The thick texture becomes a rich lather once it is wet between the hands. It feels very velvety on the skin. I have very sensitive skin and this does not sting or strip the skin barrier. It is paired well after an oil cleanser when washing the face from makeup. My pores look visibly clear and my overall skin has a nice glow.

If you're looking for a great product to clean your face, this is the one! I personally have dry skin, so I only use it once a week. It's pretty powerful, so if you have combination or oily skin, you'll probably enjoy using it daily. However, my dry skin can only handle it once a week. I like to think of it as a clay mask that really cleans out my pores and leaves my skin looking radiant. Overall, it's a fantastic product!
